candidates.name: National Polygon Service
verified_facts: HM Land Registry describes National Polygon data as indicative shape and position of registered-title boundaries.
Every freehold or leasehold title has at least one index polygon.
The dataset includes polygon identification, title number, creation date, update date and polygon version.
semantic_limits: The service page is used only to define index-polygon semantics; no paid dataset was purchased or required, and indicative polygon geometry is not exact legal-boundary or elevation evidence.

candidates.name: HM Land Registry MapSearch
verified_facts: MapSearch can establish whether land is registered and provide title number and tenure context.
Saved MapSearch snapshots are for reference purposes.
HM Land Registry states MapSearch information does not carry indemnity provisions.
semantic_limits: MapSearch is registration/location context only and cannot replace official title evidence, exact boundary geometry or parcel elevation sampling.
